name: example-sso
description: A Cloudflare Worker OIDC provider for first-party web applications

scripts.check: pnpm lint && pnpm format:check && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test
scripts.db:migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local --config wrangler.jsonc
scripts.lint:code: biome lint src scripts test vitest.config.ts && oxlint --config .oxlintrc.json --type-aware --max-warnings=0 --report-unused-disable-directives-severity=error src scripts test vitest.config.ts
scripts.format: biome format --write src scripts test package.json tsconfig.json vitest.config.ts biome.json .oxlintrc.json .markdownlint-cli2.jsonc wrangler.jsonc wrangler.operator.jsonc
scripts.format:check: biome format src scripts test package.json tsconfig.json vitest.config.ts biome.json .oxlintrc.json .markdownlint-cli2.jsonc wrangler.jsonc wrangler.operator.jsonc
scripts.types:check: wrangler types worker-configuration.d.ts --check --config wrangler.jsonc && wrangler types worker-operator-configuration.d.ts --check --config wrangler.operator.jsonc --env-interface OperatorEnv
